thesis: The speakers argue that modern universities were historically designed to train only a small fraction of the global population but now face a structural crisis as they attempt to accommodate a much larger demographic. They propose a two-part solution involving fixing existing institutions to improve outcomes and building new entities, such as startups or nonprofits, to address the scaling problem and reach students who are currently underserved.
